regions.merged_text: I hope you are well. I've tried a number of times to start this card; now its 10:15 P.M. Was just talking with Mary. She is in great hopes that you will succeed in getting "Mother and Dad Jim" for a trip East. I think it would give (Jim at least) them another lease of ten yrs. Be sure and write them I said so. I've been wanting to write them so long. Have about sixty letters ahead to answer. Well! Well: so Annie O Brien is to celebrate her golden Wed'g. I remember her quite well - knew before she was married. I surely will remember them in Mass tomorrow
